readers.framing: a maintainer of the library who has to implement this requirement and wants to know exactly what code to write

readings.summary: Keep running the source generator's analysis path when suppression is enabled, but skip only the source-emission step.
readings.code_difference: Move or narrow the SuppressSourceGeneration check so diagnostics are still computed and reported while generated files are not emitted, rather than independently changing the analyzer's execution or packaging.

readings.summary: Make the analyzer execute independently of source generation so it reports MsgPack0xx diagnostics even when the generator never runs.
readings.code_difference: Decouple or separately register/package the analyzer diagnostics from the generator, allowing the SuppressSourceGeneration check to continue preventing the entire generator from running without disabling analyzer diagnostics.

output.quote: The analyzer does not work if `SuppressSourceGeneration = true`.

readers.framing: the person who filed this issue, later checking whether what shipped is what they asked for

readings.summary: SuppressSourceGeneration must disable only source generation, while the MessagePack analyzers continue running and reporting applicable MsgPack0xx diagnostics as they did in 3.1.0.
readings.code_difference: Analyzer registration or execution must no longer be gated by SuppressSourceGeneration=true, but generated source must still be omitted and behavior when the property is false or unset must remain unchanged.

readers.framing: a QA engineer who has to write acceptance tests for this requirement before any code exists

readings.summary: With SuppressSourceGeneration=true, source generation remains disabled but all applicable MsgPack0xx analyzer diagnostics are reported, while behavior when the property is false or unset remains unchanged.
readings.code_difference: The analyzer diagnostics must execute independently of whether source generation is suppressed, without re-enabling generated output or altering normal analyzer behavior.
